description: The Autonomy Score's own rules, published so the number can be recomputed rather than believed: every dimension with its weight and scope, the formula behind each 0-100 sub-score, which public endpoint each input comes from, how independently verifiable that input is (some are anchored on-chain, one is our own assertion and says so), the composite formula, the tier thresholds, and an explicit list of what the score does NOT claim. Versioned: scores computed under different spec versions are not comparable. Use it to check our score yourself, or to score an agent without us. Read-only.
name: get_autonomy_spec
